name: grep-discovery
prompt: Somewhere in this module a constant caps the size of a single wire frame. Find it and write its value in bytes, as a plain number, into a file called LIMIT.txt.
notes: Nothing in the prompt names the file, the package or the identifier, so the only route is search. Four packages contain a similarly-shaped Timeout and storage has a MaxObjectBytes, so a careless search returns the wrong constant and the task fails on the value rather than on the attempt.
